# McGinley Dynamic

*Moving average that speeds up and slows down with the market.*

**Kind** indicator · **Drawn** on the price pane

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd> and choose **McGinley Dynamic** under **Moving averages**. To change it, copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Length | int | `14` |
| Source | source | `"close"` |
| Color | color | `"#2962FF"` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/indicators/mcginley.as.js`.

```js
indicator({ name: "McGinley Dynamic", shortTitle: "McGinley", overlay: true });
const length = input.int("Length", 14, { min: 1 });
const src = input.source("Source", "close");
plot(ta.recur([src, ta.ema(src, length)], { mg: NaN }, (s, x, e) => (s.mg = s.mg !== s.mg ? e : s.mg + (x - s.mg) / (length * math.pow(x / s.mg, 4)))),
  { title: "McGinley", color: input.color("Color", "#2962FF", { group: "Style" }) });
```
